exam.title: English Exam
exam.description: Test your English skills with listening passages and multiple choice questions.

sections.title: Airport
sections.passage: I arrived at the airport early. I went to the check-in counter and got my ______ pass. Then I checked my bag and went to the security area. Finally, I waited at the ______ for my flight.
sections.script: I arrived at the airport early. I went to the check-in counter and got my boarding pass. Then I checked my bag and went to the security area. Finally, I waited at the gate for my flight.

sections.title: Flight
sections.passage: The flight was delayed for one hour. We stayed at the gate and listened to the ______. When boarding started, I found my seat and put my bag in the overhead ______.
sections.script: The flight was delayed for one hour. We stayed at the gate and listened to the announcement. When boarding started, I found my seat and put my bag in the overhead bin.

sections.title: Hotel Visit
sections.passage: I arrived at the hotel in the afternoon. The ______ helped me check in and gave me my room key. He also gave me a city map and some travel ______.
sections.script: I arrived at the hotel in the afternoon. The concierge helped me check in and gave me my room key. He also gave me a city map and some travel brochures.

sections.title: Restaurant Order
sections.passage: We went to a restaurant for dinner. I ordered an ______ as a starter and then a main course. The food was delicious, and the ______ was excellent.
sections.script: We went to a restaurant for dinner. I ordered an appetizer as a starter and then a main course. The food was delicious, and the service was excellent.

sections.title: Food Complaint
sections.passage: The food was not good. The chicken was under______ and the soup was too salty. I called the waiter and asked him to take it ______.
sections.script: The food was not good. The chicken was undercooked and the soup was too salty. I called the waiter and asked him to take it back.

sections.title: Travel Experience
sections.passage: Last summer, I went on a ______ to the Caribbean. We visited many islands and enjoyed sightseeing. It was one of the best ______ I've ever had.
sections.script: Last summer, I went on a cruise to the Caribbean. We visited many islands and enjoyed sightseeing. It was one of the best vacations I've ever had.

sections.title: Asking for Directions
sections.passage: I got lost in the city center. I asked someone for ______ to the museum. They showed me the way and gave me a helpful ______.
sections.script: I got lost in the city center. I asked someone for directions to the museum. They showed me the way and gave me a helpful map.

sections.title: Work Project
sections.passage: We are working on a big project at the office. The manager asked for a status ______ every week. We must finish everything before the ______.
sections.script: We are working on a big project at the office. The manager asked for a status report every week. We must finish everything before the deadline.

sections.title: Event Planning
sections.passage: We are planning a company event. We need to make a ______ for the guests and book a restaurant. I also need to check the ______ for available dates.
sections.script: We are planning a company event. We need to make a reservation for the guests and book a restaurant. I also need to check the schedule for available dates.

sections.title: Vacation Plan
sections.passage: Next month, I'm going on a weekend ______. I want to relax and visit some tourist ______. I also plan to take many photos.
sections.script: Next month, I'm going on a weekend getaway. I want to relax and visit some tourist attractions. I also plan to take many photos.

sections.title: Check-in Process
sections.passage: I arrived at the airport two hours early. I went to the check-in ______ and showed my passport. The agent printed my boarding pass and tagged my ______. Then I proceeded to the security check.
sections.script: I arrived at the airport two hours early. I went to the check-in counter and showed my passport. The agent printed my boarding pass and tagged my luggage. Then I proceeded to the security check.

sections.title: On the Plane
sections.passage: After boarding the plane, I found my ______ quickly. I placed my carry-on bag in the overhead ______. The flight attendant asked me to fasten my ______.
sections.script: After boarding the plane, I found my seat quickly. I placed my carry-on bag in the overhead bin. The flight attendant asked me to fasten my seatbelt. Then the plane was ready for takeoff.

sections.title: At Immigration
sections.passage: When I arrived, I went through ______ control. The officer asked me about the ______ of my visit. I showed my passport and answered his questions.
sections.script: When I arrived, I went through immigration control. The officer asked me about the purpose of my visit. I showed my passport and answered his questions. Then he stamped my passport.

sections.title: Ordering Food
sections.passage: We sat down at the restaurant and looked at the ______. I decided to try a ______ chicken dish. My friend ordered a salad and a ______.
sections.script: We sat down at the restaurant and looked at the menu. I decided to try a grilled chicken dish. My friend ordered a salad and a soup. We also asked for some drinks.

sections.title: Restaurant Experience
sections.passage: The restaurant was very ______ that night. The service was a bit ______, but the food was amazing. In the end, we left a good ______.
sections.script: The restaurant was very busy that night. The service was a bit slow, but the food was amazing. The waiter was polite and helpful. In the end, we left a good tip.

sections.title: Travel Plan
sections.passage: We planned our ______ carefully before leaving. We made a ______ of places we wanted to visit. We also ______ a hotel in advance.
sections.script: We planned our trip carefully before leaving. We made a list of places we wanted to visit. We also booked a hotel in advance. Everything was well organized.

sections.title: Giving Directions
sections.passage: The tourist asked me how to get to the ______. I told him to go ______ and then turn left. After that, he should walk for two ______.
sections.script: The tourist asked me how to get to the museum. I told him to go straight and then turn left. After that, he should walk for two blocks. The museum would be on his right.

sections.title: Work Meeting
sections.passage: We had an important ______ this morning. The manager discussed the project ______. We agreed to finish the work before the ______.
sections.script: We had an important meeting this morning. The manager discussed the project schedule. Everyone shared their ideas and updates. We agreed to finish the work before the deadline.

sections.title: Shopping Errands
sections.passage: I had many ______ to do today. First, I went to the ______ store to buy food. Then I visited the bank and the ______.
sections.script: I had many errands to do today. First, I went to the grocery store to buy food. Then I visited the bank and the pharmacy. It was a very busy day.

sections.title: Weekend Trip
sections.passage: Last weekend, I went on a short ______. I stayed in a small ______ near the beach. I spent most of my time relaxing and ______.
sections.script: Last weekend, I went on a short getaway. I stayed in a small hotel near the beach. I spent most of my time relaxing and sightseeing. It was a wonderful experience.

multipleChoice.question: Have you eaten yet? → No, not ______.
The food was so hot ______ I couldn't eat it.
She is one of the ______ students.
We will finish the work ______ Monday.
